info.name: Orostelco
info.summary: A Nextcloud front end for telco OSS/BSS applications
info.description:
Orostelco is a graphical user interface for telco OSS/BSS applications, built into Nextcloud.
**Early alpha:** this release is a work in progress and not meant for production use.
* Top menu entry with a Vue 3 page that talks to the Orostelco API * Administration settings for the instance wide Orostelco API endpoint and API key (the key is stored encrypted) * German translation, following the Nextcloud user language * Call log of API requests in its own database table
Requires Nextcloud 33 to 35 and PHP 8.2 or newer.
info.author: Mirza Abazovic
